evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; the required growth-atmosphere verification is unavailable.
Pressure has risen progressively to 3.228 Torr at unchanged argon setpoint; this warrants investigation but does not identify a cause.
Temperature 750.2 C and argon 99.8 sccm track setpoints of 750 C and 100 sccm; controller reports running, which does not verify atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; pressure acceptance limits and an independent pressure/exhaust-path check are needed to evaluate the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
